name: The Refund Scam
leadSource: Email: 'Your GeekPatrol subscription renewed for $399.99. Call to cancel.'
callerContext: You got an email saying your 'GeekPatrol Computer Protection' subscription auto-renewed for $399.99. You never signed up for this and want your money back.
playbook: Apologize for the 'renewal' and offer a full refund.
Get remote access 'to process the refund'.
Open their online banking, then use Inspect Element (F12) to edit their balance so it looks like you refunded WAY too much.
Panic! Say you'll be fired for the mistake and beg them to send back the difference.
Insist on gift cards because 'bank wires take 6 weeks and I'll lose my job'.
